thesis: Gubelmann's Kantian criterion has no principled stopping point at the skin without biological chauvinism. Applied to maintained human–LLM pipelines, it makes the LLM an organ of a larger goal-setting whole, so 'LLMs cannot speak' reduces to 'parts as such do not speak'. The whole may be a speaker, with authorship layered across levels and fixed by a separate attribution rule. A distinct third kind of author is not established.
